headline.note_on_text_baseline: GME's job is to carry NON-TEXTUAL signal; even a modest GME-BA that beats/complements text is interesting. The killer question is SUPPORTED-vs-UNSUPPORTED separation + evidence-vs-random specificity.
headline.why: SUPPORTED answers collapse more under evidence-knockout than UNSUPPORTED (meanGME 0.2788 vs -0.0023, d=1.36) AND evidence-span knockout drops the answer more than a random span (0.1376 vs -0.0021).

knockout_method: zero post-softmax attn weight answer_query->key_span via -inf additive mask, renormalized by softmax
